title: Mushroom Risotto
description: Rich and creamy risotto with mixed mushrooms, white wine, fresh herbs, and Parmesan cheese. Perfect for an elegant dinner that's surprisingly approachable.

steps.title: Sauté the mushrooms
steps.body: Heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in a Dutch oven over medium heat. Add mushrooms, 1/2 teaspoon salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the mushrooms are soft and browned around the edges. This takes about 8 minutes. Remove the mushrooms and set aside.

steps.title: Start the risotto base
steps.body: Wipe the pan clean. Add the remaining 2 tablespoons oil, onion, and 1/4 teaspoon salt. Cook for 5-8 minutes until softened. Stir in the garlic, thyme, and rice; cook for 1 minute until fragrant. Add the wine and cook for 1-3 minutes until mostly reduced.

steps.title: Add broth gradually and stir
steps.body: Add the warmed broth 3/4 cup at a time, stirring constantly until each addition is nearly absorbed before adding the next. This gradual process releases the rice's starches, creating a creamy texture. With the final broth addition, stir in two-thirds of the cooked mushrooms. Continue stirring until the risotto is creamy and the rice is al dente.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.body: Stir in the cheese and season to taste with additional salt and pepper. Top with the remaining sautéed mushrooms, garnish with fresh parsley, and serve immediately with extra cheese on the side.
